gates.observed_pattern: Third reel delay and teaser styling are increased when first two reels show scatter symbols.
gates.required_state: Reel timing, audio, haptics and suspense are independent of whether a losing result is near a bonus or win.

gates.observed_pattern: Bonus rounds schedule subsequent spin() calls automatically.
gates.required_state: Every paid or value-bearing round requires deliberate player initiation; no autoplay-equivalent continuation.

gates.observed_pattern: confirmBuyBonus deducts balance and forces bonus symbols/spins.
gates.required_state: Feature-buy is disabled in the baseline welfare-first build and cannot bypass session/risk gates.

gates.observed_pattern: A big-win ticker presents recent wins and 'waiting for first big hit' messaging as live social proof.
gates.required_state: No simulated, selectively sampled or urgency-producing social proof; any public statistics require auditable provenance and neutral presentation.

gates.observed_pattern: Outcome construction checks a local pool before preserving certain wins.
gates.required_state: Certified RNG/game mathematics are independent of house pool state, player balance, loss history, risk state and marketing state.

gates.observed_pattern: Balance and stake are visible, but complete elapsed-time, total-staked, total-returned and net-session accounting is not the primary persistent truth surface.
gates.required_state: Persistent session truth shows elapsed time, total staked, total returned and net position.

gates.observed_pattern: Legacy celebration logic requires review against net outcome semantics.
gates.required_state: Payout <= stake cannot trigger win celebration, win sound, win haptic or misleading positive copy.

gates.observed_pattern: Legacy spin path checks balance but not a unified eligibility/limit/risk decision.
gates.required_state: Every real-money round must receive ALLOW from age/jurisdiction/session/limit/self-exclusion/risk gates before stake commitment.
